subject: general
question: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India located?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mumbai.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central Office of the RBI was established in Calcutta (now Kolkata) but was moved to Bombay (now Mumbai) in 1937.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India, chiefly known as RBI, is India's central bank and regulatory body responsible for the regulation of the Indian banking system.
 
• It is responsible for the control, issue, and maintaining the supply of the Indian rupee.
 
• Following India's independence on 15 August 1947, the RBI was nationalised on 1 January 1949.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **3 Major functions of RBI (Reserve Bank of India):__**

 
 
• ​**Banker to the Government**. 
 
• Custodian of the Cash Reserves of Commercial Banks.
 
• Custodian of the country's forex reserves.
